name: OpenTabletDriver
description: Self-updater downloads GitHub release zips over HTTPS with zero verification. Plugin channel SHA-256 comes from the same org metadata and is skipped when the hash field is absent.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.
